result.summary: This item was raised at inspection and the tenant is responsible for it: the front garden needs tidying. The tenant replied on 26 Feb (event 013) saying it would be finished that evening and photos would follow the next morning. The right step is to wait for the photos. I replaced the open hold, which had no follow-up date, with one that chases in 2 days. I also sent the tenant a short correction because the 26 Feb email (event 011) gave the wrong property address. No landlord money or approval is involved.
result.situation: An inspection found the front garden at Flat 4, 174 Beacon Close needed attention, and the tenant was asked to deal with it and send photos. The agency chased by email on 1, 8 (sent twice), 20 and 26 Feb, and by phone on 13 Feb. The tenant had been delayed by a family member's hospital stay. On 26 Feb they promised to finish that evening and send photos the next morning. The 26 Feb chaser (event 011) wrongly named "Flat 2, 72 Lantern Quay, Eastmere" as the address.
